info.title: Green Pavlodar — PostgreSQL planning API
info.description: Auth, reference data and planning calculations are supported. Task/report/photo/Outcomes workflow is not migrated. Other domains return 503 CLOUD_ENDPOINT_UNSUPPORTED. Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict sessions; CSRF and idempotency required on writes. No SQLite or mock fallback.
